messages:
Nina (People Ops): Heads-up everyone  we're doing a focused 'attestation boomerang' next month to catch late or partial SOC2/ISO evidence submissions. If your team hasn't completed attestation or uploaded required artifacts, you'll get a ping and a short remediation checklist. Target close date: Tue Jun 7 COB.

Carlos (Eng): What counts as "partial"? We uploaded most stuff but missing one runbook screenshot.

Nina (People Ops): Partial = any control listed as 'in progress' in the intake tracker. Missing single screenshots should be marked 'partial' so auditors know the gap and owners can finish before the close date.

Tess (Security): Quick security note: for partial submissions, include a short note on why the artifact is missing and the expected ETA. If the missing thing is an export you can't get (legacy system), tag it as a known exception and include compensating controls.

Ellen (Compliance): We're also adjusting the attestation email cadence: initial ping at 14 days, nudges at 7 days and 48 hours. During the boomerang window we'll add a 24-hour "finalize or escalate" message. Teams that miss the final deadline will be escalated to their director and copied to Security/Compliance.

Carlos (Eng): Can a team request a one-week extension if they're blocked by vendor access?

Ellen (Compliance): Yes, extensions are allowed for documented access blockers. Use the extension form on the intake page and include the blocking ticket ID. We'll review within 48 hours.

reminder-bot: Reminder scheduled: attestation boomerang kickoff in 30 days. Auto-reminders will post at 14d, 7d, 48h, 24h.

Nina (People Ops): Two operational notes: 1) we're asking each team to confirm a single attestation contact (not the whole team) in the tracker; 2) we'll publish a "missing-item playbook" with quick export commands for common systems (Datadog, GCP, Okta) to speed things up.

Carlos (Eng): Appreciate the playbook. Could we get the Datadog dashboard export command ahead of time?

Tess (Security): I'll paste the quick Datadog snippet in the doc. Also, filename tip: prefix with team and control ID, e.g., payments-C-03-dd-20260601.json. Saves auditors a lot of time.

Ellen (Compliance): We're also running two 20-min office hours during the boomerang week: Mon 10:00 PT and Thu 16:30 PT for quick unblock help. If your team needs an on-call walkthrough, DM me and we'll set a slot.

Carlos (Eng): Nomination: I put Priya as attestation contact for payments. Uploaded the dashboard export and a short note for the missing runbook screenshot.

Nina (People Ops): Thanks Carlos  I'll mark payments as 'partial' and tick the 48h reminder. Everyone else: please confirm contacts by EOW so we don't have to chase later. :pray:
